CleanYourTV profile for TCL C6K (G08). Each component is optional. Source: Gathin23/cleanyourtv, examples/tcl-65c6k-google-tv/debloat.txt (MIT). AirPlay, Cast, HDMI and input services remain available.

Choose only components you do not use. This list includes Google Assistant, Alexa, Play Games, YouTube Music, TCL channels and the TCL soundbar firmware updater. Disabling one removes its features. Backups are saved before each change. Processing stops on the first error. Use Restore to undo completed changes.

This disables the stock home screen and its recommendations. First select this launcher as the system default and return here with the real Home button. Button interception alone is not enough. A private backup is saved before disabling. Use Restore here to undo.
